subject: Media Literacy
title: The Birth of the Internet
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Birth of the Internet.

hook.text: In 1969, a UCLA computer sent 'LO' to Stanford before crashing. It was trying to type 'LOGIN.'

buildup.text: ARPANET connected four universities. Within decades, it became the internet — connecting billions.

discovery.text: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1991, making the internet usable for everyone.

twist.text: The internet was designed for resilience — no central point of failure. That also means no central editor.

climax.text: For the first time, anyone could publish to the entire world without permission from a gatekeeper.

punchline.text: The internet removed the gatekeepers. And the gates.

quiz.question: What made the internet fundamentally different from previous media?
options: Anyone could publish without a gatekeeper
